title: PresenceEnvelope
description:
A signed live-presence heartbeat as it travels over the wire.

Mirrors [`Envelope`] exactly (same framing, same signing rule): the signature
is computed over the canonical-JSON (RFC 8785) encoding of `payload` only.
Presence is a separate, additive channel from the attestation `Envelope` — it
carries no billing facts, only which sessions are currently live.

deviceId.description: ULID of the device that produced and signed this heartbeat.

payload.description: The presence heartbeat being attested to.

Harness.description:
Which harness produced a session.

`Generic` is a tool piping events through the JSON-lines adapter — distinct
from `Manual` (a human `dira start` dira): these are agent-style events from
an unmodeled harness.

PresencePing.description:
A single heartbeat: the set of sessions a device considers live right now.

Heartbeats are stateless snapshots — the cloud derives liveness from the most
recent ping per device, never by accumulating deltas.

deviceId.description: ULID of the producing device (matches the envelope).

presenceTtlSecs.description:
The device's configured presence TTL in seconds — how long the cloud should
treat this beat as fresh before considering the device offline. Sent in-band
so the cloud knows the device's intended TTL even before it answers with a
[`PresenceAck`]. Optional + omitted-when-None so older payloads (and the
signing vector) stay byte-identical.

sentAt.description: RFC 3339 timestamp the heartbeat was assembled.

sessions.description: The sessions this device currently considers live.

PresenceSession.description: A live session as seen at heartbeat time. Presence-only — never a billing base.

agentWallSeconds.description:
Active agent run-time in seconds (gap-counted, idle gaps excluded) — NOT
session wall span.

branch.description: The session branch (`git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD`), if resolved.

engagedSeconds.description: Human-engaged seconds observed for this session so far. Evidence, not billed.

identityEmail.description: `git config user.email` of the person the session is attributed to.

idle.description: Whether the session is currently idle (no recent activity signal).

lastSignalAt.description: RFC 3339 timestamp of the last activity signal observed for this session.

sessionId.description: Harness session id, or daemon-issued ULID for manual sessions.

SessionKind.description: How a piece of work was captured. Drives assurance on the cloud side.

oneOf.description: An AI coding harness session (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode).
A manual `dira start` dira (meeting, manual testing, etc.).
